input.summary:
Keepers' gallery lit: all 286 floor cells now at 8+ (min 8, mean 9.9, 0 dim, 0 dark), walk OK 286/286; same 12 hanging lanterns and chains, plus the existing candle, no lamps added.
Only the four designer lantern/chain positions moved, in parts/room-12.mjs: (18,17)→(16,18), (31,17)→(33,16), (34,17)→(37,17), (9,15)→(8,17).
make.sh rebuilt build.nbt; parts-report shows 0 refused writes for the gallery.
left: The brief says 25 dim cells, but the unmodified module measured 10 dim (min 5), so the 25 figure does not match this build; I went by the measured map.

Lanterns stay at y16 under chains at y17 from the loft floor (y18), as the designer laid them; the tool's suggested standing lanterns on the floor at y13 (34,13,17 and 9,13,15) were not used because they sit in the walking lane.
mcd walk does not climb, so the moved chains and lanterns were checked by the room tool's light and walk reports only, not by a render.

waste.what: Finding which floor cells were dim: I parsed the room tool's printed light map with awk and counted columns by hand to get coordinates (the tool prints no cell list).
waste.cost: One awk parse per iteration, about 4 runs
waste.tool: mcd room / mcd light should print the dim and dark cell coordinates (x,y,z) and the level of each, not only the map

waste.what: Choosing which existing lantern to move and to where, by trial: edit the room module, make.sh, read the report, repeat (4 moves over 4 rebuilds).
waste.tool: mcd room --suggest-moves, or a light-source sweep that ranks hanging spots at y16 by how many dim cells each would lift, so a designer's lanterns can be retuned in one pass

waste.what: The lantern suggestions were all standing lanterns on the floor (y13). Hanging spots that lift the same cells had to be found by hand.
waste.cost: Worked out the light distance for each candidate by hand
waste.tool: mcd light suggestions filtered to hanging spots under chains (the mode the lamplighter brief asks for)

companions.task: Confirm the four moved lanterns and chains (16,18), (33,16), (37,17), (8,17) keep the desk and second table in view and the walkway lanes clear; the designer owns the room module.
Check that each chain at y17 hangs from the loft floor slab at y18 and the lanterns hang cleanly from it, since a render of the walkway would show it.
